title: DKR-R mod metadata (dkr.json)
description: DKR-specific metadata at the root of a code mod (.nrm or .dkrcode). Mirrors the package inspector in runtime-recomp/src/game/mods/magic_code_package.cpp plus the SDK 2 layers in patches/sdk2/. Unknown keys are ignored by the inspector, so editor-only keys such as $schema are allowed. Duplicate keys and nesting deeper than 20 levels are rejected. Cross-file rules (resources must exist in the archive, live_options must name Number/Enum options in mod.json) are not expressible here.

$schema.title: Editor schema
$schema.description: Optional editor hint. The inspector ignores it.

schema.title: Metadata schema
schema.description: Metadata schema version. Still 1 for both APIs; API 2 is selected with api: 2, not by changing schema. Write integers without a decimal point; the loader rejects 1.0.

api.title: Executable API
api.description: DKR SDK API major version the mod is built against. API 2 unlocks development sessions, portable profiles, live reload, live options and v2 modules. Write integers without a decimal point; the loader rejects 2.0.

activation.title: Activation
activation.description: When code changes apply. Only restart is supported: code changes require a new game session.

online.title: Online execution mode
online.description: Deterministic online policy. offline-only (the default) keeps the mod out of online sessions; deterministic declares the mod safe to run in lockstep.

revisions.title: Supported ROM revisions
revisions.description: ROM revisions the mod supports. One or two distinct values.

requires.title: SDK module versions
requires.description: SDK modules the mod imports, mapped to the module version. Versions run from 1 up to the mod's api (API 1 mods can only require version 1). Write integers without a decimal point; the loader rejects 1.0.

systems.title: Exclusive systems
systems.description: Exclusive systems this mod owns. Two enabled mods that claim the same system are rejected at preparation.

conflicts.title: Conflicting mods
conflicts.description: Mod IDs this mod can't be enabled alongside.

requires_tracks.title: Course dependencies
requires_tracks.description: Course identities the mod needs installed. Distinct non-empty strings of at most 160 characters.

resources.title: Immutable resources
resources.description: Logical resource IDs mapped to archive-relative files. No absolute paths, parent-directory escapes, backslashes, colons, Windows reserved names or non-ASCII; each file can be mapped once and must exist in the archive. mod.json, dkr.json, mod_binary.bin and mod_syms.bin can't be resources. tools-ui (API 2 only) and source-map have their own schema: 2.

development.title: Development session
development.description: API 2 only: opt into development saves. Must be a boolean for any API; ignored under API 1.

profile.title: Portable SDK profile
profile.description: API 2 only: portable budget profile. compact (32 KiB heap, 100k instructions, 32 native calls), standard (64 KiB, 200k, 128, the default) or large (256 KiB, 500k, 256). Ignored under API 1.

live_reload.title: Live reload
live_reload.description: API 2 development mods only: offline instruction-only reload. Needs development: true and a nonzero state_schema.

state_schema.title: Reload state schema
state_schema.description: Nonzero 32-bit version of the state carried across a live reload. Required with live_reload and only checked then. Write integers without a decimal point; the loader rejects 1.0.

live_options.title: Live options
live_options.description: API 2 mods that require live-settings2: option IDs from mod.json config_schema that may change mid-race. Only Number and Enum options qualify.
